LESSON: SANITATION/ PRACTICES

Grade: PP1
Subject: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
Strand: HEALTH
Topic 2.4: Sanitation/ PRACTICES

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Sanitation/ PRACTICES. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify toilet facilities (10 Lesson)
2. talk about the importance of toilet facilities for personal hygiene,
3. express the urge for permission to go to toilets toileting,
4. use toilet facilities properly for personal hygiene, use of toileting facilities e) appreciate the need to use clean toilet for need to use clean toilet/ latrine for personal hygiene. appropriate use of toilet facilities Core-Competence to be developed; 130

Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: At school, pick litter and put it in the bin. That cares for the environment.

Example 2: Wash your hands with soap before eating and after using the toilet.

Example 3: Name two foods you eat at home that help you grow strong.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Sanitation/ PRACTICES.
2. Explain Sanitation/ PRACTICES to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Sanitation/ PRACTICES.
4. Show that you can: identify toilet facilities (10 Lesson)
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Sanitation/ PRACTICES. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: Why is Sanitation/ PRACTICES important to you?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 8: REMEMBER
